title: MODEL TEST ONLY - recreates two beats of Hidden By Design's drainage video. Never post.
style: Vertical 9:16 realistic 3D engineering illustration of a quiet suburban street in daylight. Cream houses with red tile roofs and blue shutters stand behind a curving asphalt road. Keep a large leafy tree on the left and an open water channel on the right. Reveal a deep brown soil cross-section beneath the foreground road. Use a clear elevated view, natural materials, readable lighting and no text or arrows.
rules: Only physically possible events; water obeys gravity and flows downhill.
Everything already built stays exactly in place.
The houses, tree, road and channel stay the same.

lines.text: So you connect a pipe from the bottom of the hole to carry the water away.
Now the water moves, but it carries leaves, mud and a lost tennis ball into the pipe.

frames.shows: The road is intact: no hole, pipes, grate or equipment yet.
A square hole has been cut through the road into the soil cross-section, and it is full of rainwater right up to the road surface. No pipes yet.

A grey pipe now runs from the bottom of the hole sideways and slightly downhill through the soil and out into the open water channel on the right, where the water pours out into the channel. The water level in the hole has dropped.

frames.camera: it has moved down and about twice as close to the pipe, which still runs left to right in exactly the same direction and position as before; the road edge is still visible at the top
frames.shows: Through the cut-away side of the same pipe, water flows from left to right carrying a few brown leaves, some mud and a yellow-green tennis ball.

clips.motion: A grey pipe slides into place from the bottom of the hole toward the channel, and the water in the hole drains out through it. Camera locked.
The camera moves smoothly down and closer along the pipe while water flows through it, carrying leaves, mud and a tennis ball.
